{{Top}} {{Update|[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]], [[The Separatists (reference book)|The Separatists]]}} {{Character |type=CIS |image=[[File:Poggle_the_lesser_-_sw_card_trader.png]] |name=Poggle the Lesser |homeworld=[[Geonosis]]{{SWE|characters|pogglethelesser|Poggle the Lesser}} |birth= |death=[[19 BBY]], [[Mustafar]]{{Film|III}} |species=[[Geonosian]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]])''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |mass=80 [[kilogram]]s''[[Star Wars Journeys: Beginnings]]'' |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]] |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Stalgasin hive]]''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' *[[Techno Union]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] **[[Executive Separatist Council]] *[[Galactic Republic]] {{C|briefly}}''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Geonosians do not hold life to be as precious as you humans do, Lieutenant Commander.|Poggle the Lesser, to Orson Callan Krennic|}} [[Archduke]] '''Poggle the Lesser''' was the public leader of the [[Geonosian]]s during the [[Clone Wars]]. Though subservient to the sedentary, [[Geonosian hive-mind|hive-minded]] [[Queen]] [[Karina the Great]], he was nominally in control of the [[Stalgasin hive]], and was the active, public face of the Geonosians. With his oversight of the Geonosian [[Baktoid Armor Workshop|Baktoid]] [[battle droid]] [[Factory|factories]], Archduke Poggle the Lesser became a powerful figure within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] (CIS). The Archduke was a [[warlord]], commanding [[Separatist Droid Army|droid armies]] that fought against the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis|first]] and [[Second Battle of Geonosis|second battles]] of [[Geonosis]], during the latter of which he was captured and taken into Republic custody. Incarcerated on [[Coruscant]], he was approached and recruited by the [[Republic Special Weapons Group]] to assist in the [[Project Stardust|construction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Ultimate Weapon]] [[battle station]], which the Geonosians [[Death Star plans|designed]]; however, he later absconded to Confederate [[Realspace|space]] after sabotaging the project. During the final stages of the war, he and the rest of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] were relocated to [[Utapau]], and later to [[Mustafar]], where he was ultimately [[Death|killed]] by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. ==Biography== ===Rise to power=== Once a member of the drone caste, Poggle the Lesser, with strategic aid from the manipulative [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]],{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Poggle the Lesser - Geonosian Separatist}} rose to the position of [[Archduke]] of [[Geonosis]], the public position of leadership that secretly answered to a [[Geonosian]] [[queen]].''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' Poggle also became [[controller]] of the large [[Geonosis droid factories|Geonosian droid factories]] on the [[planet]]. At some point after he became archduke, he also killed the current leader of the Geonosians, [[Hadiss]] the Vaulted, ensuring his control over Geonosis.{{BuildFalconCite|19|Guide to the Galaxy}} During the [[Separatist Crisis]], Poggle was one of the first and one of the most ardent supporters of its cause,{{SW|url=poggle-the-lesser-biography-gallery|text=Poggle the Lesser Biography Gallery}} which had been set off by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Head of State]] and former [[Jedi]] [[Dooku]].{{Film|II}} Dooku had personally ensured the droid building contract between the Geonosians and [[Baktoid Armor Workshop]] continued on. Poggle profited greatly from the arrangement, and, thanks to Dooku, rose to a position of power like that of no other Geonosian ruler before him. Despite his prominence, Sidious and Dooku viewed Poggle as highly expendable.{{HelmetCollectionCite|12|Weapons & Uniforms}} In addition to dealings with the Separatists, Poggle continued to operate as an extension of Karina the Great's rule over the Stalgasin hive,{{HelmetCollectionCite|31|Databank A-Z}} the most dominant hive on Geonosis. He would receive instructions from her on how to run the hive. ===The Clone Wars=== ====First Battle of Geonosis==== {{Quote|noquote=1|«We have to order a retreat.»''
"''My master will never allow the Republic to get away with this treachery.''"
''«I'm sending my warriors to hide in the catacombs. The Jedi must not find our designs for the Ultimate Weapon. If they find out what we are planning to build, we're doomed.»''
"''I will take the designs with me to Coruscant. They will be much safer there with my master.|Archduke Poggle the Lesser and Count Dooku|}} For the [[Geonosian accord]], he hosted a meeting of fellow Separatist conspirators on Geonosis. Poggle pledged the [[Army|armies]] of his people to Dooku. [[File:Poggle_Geo.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Poggle the Lesser inside the Geonosian Command Center, during the First Battle of Geonosis]] Poggle, Dooku, and the rest of their Separatist conspirators then went to the [[Petranaki Arena]] to watch the [[Death penalty|executions]] of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. However, [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] and a [[Jedi assault team|team of 212 Jedi]] arrived to [[First Battle of Geonosis|rescue]] Kenobi, Skywalker, and Amidala. As the [[battle droid]]s overwhelmed the Jedi, they were then rescued by [[clone trooper]]s under [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]]. Poggle and the rest of the separatist conspirators then went to the underground [[Geonosian War Room]] to oversee the battle. As the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic Army]] forced their [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]] to retreat, Poggle ordered his warriors to hide in the [[Geonosian catacombs|catacombs]]. He then gave Dooku the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|ultimate weapon]], who assured that they would be safe with his [[Sith Master|Master]], [[Darth]] Sidious. ====Dealings with Clovis==== {{Quote|Are you suggesting we change the terms of our agreement? No. A deal's a deal.|Rush Clovis to Lott Dod and Poggle the Lesser|{{TCW|Senate Spy}}}} [[File:PoggleLottDod-SS.jpg|thumb|right|272x272px|Lott Dod and Poggle]] Poggle, along with [[Trade Federation]] Senator [[Lott Dod]], conspired with [[Scipio]] Senator [[Baron]] [[Rush Clovis]] to rebuild the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|primary droid foundry]] on Geonosis. When Clovis arrived on [[Cato Neimoidia]] at [[Great Vaults of Cato Neimoidia|Dod's palace]], Poggle and Dod [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia|demanded a greater share of the profits]] than the [[foundry]] would produce. When Clovis refused to change the terms, Poggle agreed with Dod's plan to [[poison]] his companion, Padmé Amidala. However, Clovis helped Amidala's guard (who was really Anakin Skywalker in disguise) get the [[antidote]] for her. Poggle and Dod then confronted Clovis about the missing [[Hologram disc|holodisc]]. ====Second Battle of Geonosis==== {{Quote|Poggle is out in the open, and I intend to grab him before he can get offworld.|Luminara Unduli|{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}}} Poggle returned to Geonosis and served as the [[Overseer]] of the new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]] However, the war would soon return to the Geonosian [[homeworld]]. When the Galactic Republic [[Second Battle of Geonosis|invaded]] the planet, Poggle led both the droid army and the native Geonosians against the Republic.{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} As the Republic forces approached his foundry, Poggle and his [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]], [[TX-21]], oversaw the construction of [[Separatist super-tank prototype|super tank]]s. They then deployed ten [[garrison]]s of droids against the [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s serving under [[Jedi General]]s Anakin Skywalker and [[Luminara Unduli]]. Poggle and TX-21 then sent-in the super tanks, which were able to push the clones back. Poggle was then informed that two Jedi had infiltrated the reactor room; accompanied by a pair of soldiers and one of his super tanks, Poggle ordered his soldiers to [[bomb]] the Jedi.{{TCW|Weapons Factory}} [[File:PoggleRetreat-LegacyOfTerror.png|thumb|left|275px|Poggle escaped to the Temple in a damaged AAT]] After the foundry's destruction, Poggle took an [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|AAT]], along with several of his droids and soldiers, to the [[Progate Temple]]. Along the way, Poggle dropped crates, leaving a trail for Unduli and clone trooper [[Buzz]] to follow; when the two entered the temple, Poggle and several undead Geonosians ambushed and killed Buzz, and captured Unduli. Poggle then took her into the catacombs of the temple and brought her before his queen, Karina the Great, as a gift. Together, they hoped they could use Geonosian [[brain worm]]s to control Unduli. However, Poggle and Karina were soon discovered by Kenobi and Skywalker. As they blinded the queen, Poggle was captured by Skywalker and Unduli. He was taken aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Resolute]]''.{{TCW|Brain Invaders}} On board the ''Resolute'', Poggle was [[Torture|interrogated]] by Kenobi, [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and Unduli, but refused to answer their questions. When the worms were aboard his Padawan's [[TB-73|supply ship]], Skywalker interrogated Poggle alone. At first, Poggle refused but was then punched and [[Telekinesis|Force-choke]]d by the Jedi. He then revealed the worms' weakness to the [[Temperature|cold]]. Poggle was then transported to [[Coruscant]], where he was [[Prison|imprisoned]] in a cell at the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]].{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}} ====Imprisonment and Republic service==== {{Quote|Whatever it is can wait, Poggle. Your workers are dismantling everything they put together.''"
"''Try not to be too hard on them. They are simply following my orders.|Orson Krennic and Archduke Poggle the Lesser during his escape|}} [[File:PoggleIncarcerated-TJWKTM.png|thumb|right|270px|Poggle was incarcerated in the Republic Center for Military Operations]] During his [[time]] in prison, Poggle was subjected to routine interrogation by agents of [[Republic Intelligence]]. One of the main topics, even though information on it was removed by Poggle from the [[Geonosian War Room|Stalgasin war room]], of the interrogations was the supposed deep-space mobile [[battle station]] project, the "Ultimate [[Weapon]]" designed by the Stalgasin hive, that was thought to be under construction by the Confederacy. However, the Archduke repeatedly denied any Geonosian association, and feigned ignorance to the existence of the plans, which were actually in the possession of the [[Republic Special Weapons Group]]. Poggle was later approached by [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] of the Special Weapons Group, in another attempt to garner information on the Confederacy's Ultimate Weapon. Krennic, who himself was attempting to spearhead the [[Project Stardust|project]] to develop the station, was able to appeal to Poggle's loyalty to his people and convinced him to provide the Geonosian drone population as a workforce for the battle-station's construction. While Poggle would ultimately agree to Krennic's offer, he was still within a Center for Military Operations cell in [[19 BBY]].{{TCWcanondates|518}} Poggle took to flying in its midst while being watched by secruity cameras and was captured as such one day as, unknown to him, Ahsoka Tano—the same Jedi Padawan who had helped to destroy his foundry during the Second Battle of Geonosis and whom he had confronted face-to-face—was framed for the murder of anti-war activist [[Letta Turmond]] in another cell. The culprit was none-other-than Barriss Offee,{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}} the other Padawan whom Poggle had confronted and lost his factory to. With his supposed allegiance to the Republic established, the Archduke was returned to his homeworld on the eve of [[Meckgin]], in which, amidst [[blood]]y celebrations, was able to convince the Geonosians to assist in the Republic's construction efforts. However, Poggle had ulterior motives for providing such assistance to the Republic. Allotted with a private retinue of drones, Poggle secretly directed a massive uprising of the Geonosian soldiers servicing the battle-station as a diversion for his own escape to the Confederacy. In addition to sabotaging the construction project, the Archduke, with his own modified personal [[shuttle]], was able to [[Uprising on Geonosis|slip through]] the [[Republic Navy|Republic flotilla]] in [[orbit]] and flee into [[hyperspace]]. ====Last days of the Clone Wars==== After escaping from Geonosis, Poggle rejoined the Confederacy as the war began to draw to its close. Following a string of Republic victories, General Grievous ordered the members of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]], including Poggle, to remain under his protection. Grievous hid them on [[Utapau]] while he prepared a [[Battle of Coruscant|strike]] on Coruscant. Following Count Dooku's death and Grievous's failure at Coruscant, Poggle and the other Separatist leaders met with Grievous on Utapau. During the meeting, he informed them that he was transferring them to the [[Volcano|volcanic]] planet of [[Mustafar]] for their own safety. Grievous then dismissed the council, telling them that their ship was waiting shortly before his own [[Battle of Utapau|death]]. ====Death==== {{Quote|When my new apprentice, Darth Vader, arrives, he will... take care of you.|Darth Sidious, to Poggle and the other Separatist leaders|}} [[File:PoggleDies-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|Poggle's death at the hands of Darth Vader]] After arriving on Mustafar, Poggle and the rest of the Council settled in a [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility|fortified bunker]]. Soon after, they were contacted by Darth Sidious, who had informed them that his new [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], Darth Vader, would be arriving shortly, but claimed that he had come to make peace with them. When Vader arrived on Mustafar, the Separatist leaders discovered that he was sent not to reward the council, but to [[Mission to Mustafar|execute]] them. Poggle attempted to defend himself using his staff, to no avail, and was quickly [[Dismemberment|decapitated]]. Vader would eventually murder Gunray, shut down the Battle Droids and end the Clone Wars. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|With Poggle dead, the hive queen has appointed a new archduke to oversee the soldiers and drones, but the process is nothing more than conciliatory.|Lt. Commander Orson Krennic, to [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]|}} After Poggle's death, a [[Unidentified Geonosian archduke|new archduke]] was appointed by the hive queen. However, the appointment was really a way to placate the Geonosians, as the [[species]] now essentially belonged to the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire]]. The Geonosisans continued to be used in the battle station project the Republic had started, which was dubbed the "Death Star." To keep the Death Star a secret, the Empire [[Sterilization of Geonosis|sterilized]] the population of Geonosis, with only [[Klik-Klak|one Geonosian]] surviving.''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Standard decade|Decade]]s later, Poggle was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|How many of you have gazed into the heavens at night and seen something new taking shape above our world? A crescent, a circle, a gleaming ring that is like the portal to another dimension?|Poggle the Lesser describes the Death Star to his subjects|}} [[File:WeServeTheQueen-SWL113.png|thumb|right|250px|Poggle the Lesser was a cunning and charismatic leader.]] A male Geonosian who rose to the rank of archduke from that of a drone, Poggle the Lesser was an early and loyal supporter of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. While he attempted to distance Geonosis from the Separatists in front of Orson Krennic and other Republic representatives after his freedom from Republic capture, he, in time, was able to escape back to the Separatists, having never truly given his loyalty over to the Republic. Poggle was a powerful and cunning leader, being skilled at military tactics as well as negotiating. He also possessed a knowledge of [[engineer]]ing. ==Equipment== Poggle wielded the [[Staff of Command]], which was the symbol of his office. Made of [[bone]] allegedly taken from a conquered adversary, it also served as a walking stick and, due to its sharp point, a weapon if the Geonosian ruler ever felt the need to motivate or punish those around him. He was [[Clothing|clothed]] in ornate and aristocratic garments that reflected his position, wealth, and power. For similar reasons, Poggle also wore jewels as well as chain-like [[visgura thread]]. His chosen emblem of rank was [[Spider|arachnid]]-inspired, crafted from the [[egg]] cases of an extinct [[giant cave spider]]. ==Behind the scenes== Poggle the Lesser was portrayed by [[Marton Csokas]] and voiced by [[Ernie Fosselius]] in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]. The character later returned in a nonspeaking capacity in the [[2005]] sequel [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. He was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series. [[File:Poggle_maquette.jpg|left|thumb|142x142px|Poggle's marquette]] On [[July 18]], [[2000]], [[StarWars.com]] announced that Csokas would join the cast of ''Attack of the Clones'' in a role that was described as that of "a [[planet]]ary leader", an announcement that was accompanied by casting director [[Robin Gurland]]'s praise for Csokas' talents.{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/production/news20000718.html|text=Casting Update: Local Talent Continues}} Initially written to have a major role in the screenplay, Poggle's role was reduced by the time production started running.{{InsiderCite|65|Behind the Magic}} However, as the film neared completition, Csokas was informed by Gurland through a letter that his performance would be removed despite keeping a credit for it due to director [[George Lucas]] taking the decision that Poggle should be rendered through visual effects and voiced by sound effects.{{WebCite|url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/lifestyle/marton-csokas-swimming-with-hollywood-sharks/LEFFTUWT7F2G5DOAYLHGKTX3YQ|text=Marton Csokas, swimming with Hollywood sharks|author=Baillie, Russell|work=[[Wikipedia:The New Zealand Herald|The New Zealand Herald]]|archivedate=20201113204338}} Poggle would be ultimately realized by having [[Industrial Light & Magic]] animator [[Charles Alleneck]] serve as the moddle to animate his movements and sound designer [[Ben Burtt]] recorded himself reading the character's lines and playing them backwards during rehearsals, but later in production, Burtt recorded Fosselius reciting Poggle's dialogue in reverse, who also recorded some [[Wikipedia:Swahili language|Swahili]]-type clicking noises and the sound of blowing on the edge of a piece of paper, with all of this added to Poggle's voice in the finished product.''[[The Sounds of Star Wars]]'' In the DVD commentary of ''Attack of the Clones'', it is stated that Poggle was made to look different than other Geonosians so it was obvious he was their leader, similar to how [[Boss]] [[Rugor Nass|Nass]] was designed to look different from the other [[Gungan]]s.{{Film|II}} DVD commentary In a [[Content cut from Star Wars|deleted scene]] for ''Attack of the Clones'', Poggle sentences Anakin and Padmé to their deaths, finding them guilty of espionage, leading [[Nute Gunray]] to hurry him up to give the sentence. In the final cut of ''Revenge of the Sith'', Poggle gets cut in half by Darth Vader. However, in the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|illustrated screenplay]] of the film, Poggle was beheaded.[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']] According to the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' San Hill ''Base Series'' 1, Poggle joined forces with [[San Hill]], the [[Chairman]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and Dooku to [[assassin]]ate their volatile ally, the [[Kaleesh]] [[warlord]] [[Grievous]], who then wanted to rebuild into a loyal cyborg.{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=San Hill - Banking Clan Chairman}} At the time, [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated this was an outdated reference to [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] instead of a canonical fact.{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/672253588018618368|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Tweet lost, but did state that San Hill - Banking Clan Chairman - ''Base Series 1'' contains an outdated reference to Legends via San Hill, Poggle, and Dooku working together to destroy and rebuild Grievous.|nobackup=1}} However, recent canon sources have brought in similar details of Grievous's
